title: 9:00 AM — The Boom
subtitle: The city is growing. Its margins are shrinking. Describe the evidence before building a causal story.

feed.headline: MOGTOWN LOOKS ECONOMY +55%
feed.body: TrendTok finance creators celebrate another record year for the city's looksmaxxing sector.

feed.headline: #MogMonday hits 27m daily views
feed.body: Looksmaxxing videos, product reviews, GlowScore screenshots and creator discount codes dominate TrendTok. A view is an exposure, not a unique customer or purchase.

feed.headline: Consumer complaints nearly triple
feed.body: Reported complaints rose from 14,000 to 41,000 while orders also increased. The raw count and the complaint rate per order answer different questions.

feed.headline: Mayor calls 4 PM emergency hearing
feed.body: Sales are booming, but profit, delivery performance and consumer satisfaction are moving in the opposite direction.

tasks: Record 3 observations supported by a specific public or confidential metric.
Show 2 calculations. Label units and distinguish percent changes from percentage-point changes.
Identify 1 strange pattern in the data.
Do not claim causes yet: describe what happened.
callout: Fictional classroom data. Opening comparisons are 2026 → 2027. Public industry sales are recognized revenue; role dashboards label gross order values separately. Return rates use orders/units, not dollars. A percentage-point change and a percent change are different.
